headlines.title: 서울 아파트 전셋값 39개월째 상승 … 강북 첫 6억 돌파
headlines.summary: 10월 전세 7.2억, 4년전 고점보다 높아 강북 평균 6억281만원, 강남 8.4억원 서울과 전국 격차 3.36억→3.9억 확대 서울 강남구 부동산에 게시된 매매 및 전세 게시물.  [연합] 서울 아파트 평균 전세가격이 39개월 연속 상승하면서, 7억2898만원으로 사상 최대치를 경신했다. 강북 14개구 전세 가격은 처음으로 6억원을 넘겼다.

headlines.title: 경유 수출제한 완화 추진 … 업계, 해외수요 대응 기대감
headlines.summary: ‘전년의 100%’ 기준 조정 시사 경유 부족한 국가로 반출 숨통 정부가 경유 수출 물량 제한 완화를 추진하면서 정유업계의 기대감이 커지고 있다. 업계는 국내 공급에 문제가 없고 생산량도 회복됐다면서 규제 완화가 재고 부담을 덜고 해외 수요에 대응할 수 있는 계기가 될 것으로 기대하고 있다.

headlines.title: 실적 양극화 … 건설·배터리 등 산업계 곳곳 인력 감축
headlines.summary: 장기침체에 희망퇴직·전환 배치 기업 경기전망, 2개월째 부정적 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 역대급 실적을 바탕으로 초대형 주주환원에 나서고 있지만, 실적이 저조한 산업계 일각에서는 희망퇴직과 인력 재배치 등 구조조정이 잇따르고 있다. 반도체 부문만 호실적을 내는 K자형 양극화가 고용 현장에서도 나타나는 모습이다.

key_headlines.title: Pohang AI Data Center Construction Accelerates with 600 Billion Won Investment
key_headlines.summary: A major AI data center project in Pohang is moving forward with simplified local fiscal investment review procedures, targeting January 2028 operations. The project is expected to generate 1.2 trillion won in production and create 4,000 jobs with 4 billion won support from Gyeongbuk Province.

key_headlines.title: Interest Rates Surge Despite Strong Growth: Credit Loan Rates Jump to 6.33%
key_headlines.summary: While Q3 GDP grew 1.0% unexpectedly, loan rates have risen sharply, with credit loan rates increasing from 5.41% to 6.33%. Small business default rates climbed 0.1 percentage point, signaling difficulties for ordinary consumers and self-employed workers despite semiconductor boom.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Jeonse Prices Hit Record High for 39th Consecutive Month
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment jeonse prices reached 728.98 million won, an all-time high, while northern Seoul prices exceeded 600 million won for the first time. The gap between Seoul and national prices expanded to 390 million won, indicating growing regional inequality.

key_headlines.title: Q3 GDP Growth Reaches 1.0% Surpassing Expectations; Full-Year Growth Could Exceed 3.6%
key_headlines.summary: Driven by semiconductor exports and facility investments, Korea's Q3 GDP grew 1.0%, significantly exceeding initial forecasts. The Bank of Korea now projects annual growth could reach 3.6%, surpassing the previous estimate of 3.3%.

key_headlines.title: Performance Polarization: Layoffs Spread Across Construction and Battery Industries
key_headlines.summary: While Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix post record profits with massive shareholder returns, other industries facing poor results are implementing voluntary retirement and workforce restructuring. This K-shaped polarization is now visible in employment trends across sectors.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy showed mixed signals this week, with Q3 GDP growth of 1.0% exceeding expectations and potentially reaching 3.6% for the full year, yet consumer sentiment remains weak as loan interest rates have surged. Credit loan rates jumped from 5.41% to 6.33%, putting pressure on households and small businesses, with mid-sized enterprise default rates rising 0.1 percentage point. The semiconductor boom continues to drive corporate profits and investment, but the broader economy shows signs of weakness with rising business closures and financial hardship among self-employed workers.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's strong Q3 growth forecast has raised expectations for full-year performance, with some analysts suggesting annual growth could reach 4%. However, policymakers face a dilemma as carbon neutrality policies are projected to reduce average annual growth rates by 0.06-0.07 percentage points through 2060 while increasing inflation by 0.04 percentage points annually. The central bank continues to weigh additional rate increases despite expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve will hold rates steady, with Korean inflation expected to rebound to around 3% in October, constraining monetary policy flexibility.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI recovered above the 5,800 level on strong buying from foreign investors and institutions, buoyed by semiconductor stocks as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix surged following positive overnight performance on Wall Street. U.S. Treasury yields stabilized around 5% ahead of the FOMC decision, while Chinese long-term government bond yields fell to multi-year lows as funds fled equities for safe assets. Interest rate futures suggest a 92-93% probability of Fed rate holds this week, though December rate increase expectations remain elevated at around 73%.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor industry continues to lead economic growth, with Samsung Electronics reporting record Q3 operating profits of 691 billion won, up 165% year-over-year, driven by AI data center component demand. HD Construction Machinery opened a new engine plant in Gunsan to capitalize on surging AI data center power generation needs, targeting engine business revenue to nearly double by 2030. However, structural challenges persist in the battery industry, with GS Energy Materials suspending operations after accumulating 170 billion won in losses, as the industry struggles with timing mismatches between EV adoption rates and battery waste emergence.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment jeonse prices reached record highs for the 39th consecutive month at 728.98 million won, with northern Seoul prices exceeding 600 million won for the first time, matching 2021 crisis levels. The regional price gap between Seoul and the rest of the country expanded to 390 million won, reflecting severe inequality. Luxury apartments in Gangnam have shown signs of price correction, with some properties declining by billions of won, signaling market stress amid tax reforms and macro uncertainties, though strong demand for mid-range properties continues to drive overall price increases.
sections.International Economy: U.S. semiconductor stocks showed strong performance ahead of the FOMC decision, with Anthropic advancing toward record IPO fundraising of an estimated 133 trillion won in November, while SpaceX achieved profitability in Q3. Korean beauty products are expanding aggressively into European markets through platforms like Amazon, leveraging success in the U.S. market to build global distribution networks. However, tightening credit conditions for AI infrastructure investments are raising questions about funding sustainability, potentially reducing pressure for additional Federal Reserve rate increases beyond December.
sections.AI & Economy: Samsung Electronics achieved record Q3 profits largely driven by AI data center component demand, signaling the sector's critical importance to Korea's economic growth. South Korea faces the challenge of transitioning from an AI consumption leader to an AI industrial powerhouse, requiring broader adoption across small and medium enterprises, not just large corporations. HD Construction Machinery's investment in generator engines for data centers underscores the massive infrastructure requirements of AI expansion, while power and water resource management are emerging as critical competitive factors. Anthropic's unprecedented IPO signals market confidence in AI's transformative potential, though concerns persist about profitability and the sustainability of enormous infrastructure investment requirements.
sections.Others: The government expanded support for growth-oriented small and medium enterprises by exempting those planning to increase employment or investment from regular tax audits in 2025, aiming to stimulate economic vitality. Price controls on urea solution and medical syringes imposed due to Middle East war disruptions are set to expire at month-end, reflecting stabilized supply conditions. Macquarie Asset Management agreed to acquire Gavia and KINX, with golf equipment company GolfZon County valued at 1.8 trillion won being acquired by TheCeena Group, signaling consolidation in various sectors through private equity-led transactions.
